design_direction: Modern Dark Theme with Regal Gold Accents & High-End Transitions
context: Community Service & Professional Club Portal (Gwalior, India)

heading_font.usage: H1, H2, Section titles, Hero headers, Award titles. Strictly NO Inter or Roboto for headings!

body_font.usage: Body copy, member biodata details, admin forms, badges, metadata

accent_font.usage: Data stats, member IDs, timestamps, badge codes

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

surfaces_and_effects.header_nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C10]/80 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_effects.glass_card: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#131620]/90 border border-[#D4AF37]/20 rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/50 hover:shadow-[0_10px_35px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]
surfaces_and_effects.gold_glow_button: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] via-[#E5C158] to-[#B8860B] text-black font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(212,175,55,0.5)] hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300
surfaces_and_effects.privacy_blur_overlay: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60 border border-[#D4AF37]/30 rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-[#F3E5AB]

sections: Navigation Bar: Logo with rotary wheel motif, Links (Home, Members, Service Projects, Meetings, About Us), Login/Dashboard CTA, Mobile Drawer Menu

Hero Section: Parallax Gwalior heritage backdrop with subtle dark vignette gradient (from-black/80 via-black/60 to-[#0B0C10]), Gold accent badge 'ROTARY DISTRICT 3053 | GWALIOR INNOVATORS', Bold Cinzel heading, Mission statement, Action CTA 'Explore Our Impact' & 'View Members Directory'

Editorial Marquee Ribbon: Slow sliding gold-bordered marquee with keywords: 'SERVICE ABOVE SELF • INNOVATION IN COMMUNITY • HEALTHCARE DRIVE • GIRL CHILD EDUCATION • CLEAN GWALIOR INITIATIVE • YOUTH FELLOWSHIP'

Service Areas Grid (Bento Tetris Layout): Highlighting 4 core pillars: (1) Medical & Health Camps, (2) Literacy & STEM Education, (3) Eco-Gwalior Plantation, (4) Vocational & Women Empowerment. Each with gold icon, stats, and learn more trigger
Impact Counters & Stats Section: Animated counting numbers (e.g., 25,000+ Lives Touched, 140+ Projects Completed, ₹1.2 Cr Community Investment, 85 Active Innovators)
Upcoming Schedule & Meetings Preview: Next Rotary Weekly Fellowship Card (Date, Venue, Speaker, Topic, RSVP button) + Calendar list of upcoming events
Leadership Spotlight Carousel: President message & key executive members with interactive cards
Footer: Dark velvet footer with large gold Rotary Emblem watermark, quick links, contact info, meeting venue address (Gwalior Club / Taj Usha Kiran Palace), social links, copyright
Header Banner: Gold ambient hero banner 'DISTINGUISHED FELLOWS & INNOVATORS'
Filter & Search Bar: Instant search input by name, classification, company, or leadership role + Filter tabs (All, Board Members, Past Presidents, Paul Harris Fellows)
Members Grid / List Toggle: Grid view with high-end dark cards + List view for quick directory lookups

Member Card Specs: Member photo with gold subtle ring avatar, full name, Rotary classification (e.g. 'Civil Engineering', 'Cardiology', 'Jewelry Manufacturing'), Business Name, Badge 'Logged-in members see full contact details'

Member Biodata Modal / Full Page Drawer: Opens when clicking any member card. Contains: (1) Public Profile: Name, Classification, Bio, Rotary History, Committees, Social links. (2) Privacy-Protected Section: Phone Number, Email, Residential Address, Birthday, Anniversary Date, Spouse Name. GUEST STATE: Blurry frosted container with gold padlock icon, message 'Login as Rotary Member to unlock confidential directory data', quick 'Login Now' button. LOGGED-IN STATE: Cleanly revealed animated gold-accent card with direct call, email, and WhatsApp buttons.
Centred Dark Glass Login Card with gold border beam effect
Header: Rotary Wheel Gold Icon + 'Member & Admin Portal'
Form Fields: Email input, Password input, 'Remember Me' checkbox

Role Toggle / Demo Credentials Helper Box: Quick click-to-fill demo accounts: [Member Demo: member@rotarygwalior.org / member123] and [Admin Demo: admin@rotarygwalior.org / admin123] for rapid evaluation
CTA Button: Gold Glow Submit button with loading spinner state
Protected Route: Redirects to /login if not authenticated as Admin
Admin Sidebar / Top Navigation: Dashboard Stats summary, Members Management, Meetings & Schedule, Community Projects
Member Management Tab: Searchable data table with member records, 'Add New Member' modal, 'Edit Member' drawer, ability to toggle privacy flags, change member status
Meetings Management Tab: Create new Rotary fellowship meeting, set speaker, agenda, venue, time, manage member RSVPs
Events & Projects Tab: Track active community projects, record volunteer hours, upload project photos and impact metrics
Toast notifications via Sonner for all CRUD actions (Created, Updated, Deleted successfully)

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on all sections: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6 }} viewport={{ once: true }}
motion_and_interactions.lenis_scroll: Incorporate smooth scrolling for ultra-fluid page navigation
motion_and_interactions.privacy_unlock_animation: Animate backdrop filter blur reduction from blur-md to blur-0 and opacity transition when member logs in
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Hover effects should scale cards slightly (scale-102), elevate border brightness from 20% gold to 50% gold, and display inner subtle gold radial gradient light

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, inputs, buttons, navigation links, tabs, and member biodata fields MUST include kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `Cinzel` and `Plus Jakarta Sans` fonts are imported in index.html or index.css.
Ensure all pages are fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Never use plain white or default unstyled components. Gold accents should be applied with sophistication (buttons, badges, borders, icons, progress indicators).
The login state must be persistent (e.g. stored in localStorage / React Context) so logging in immediately reveals the locked biodata on the Members page.
Implement mock API / state handling for Admin operations (Add/Edit Member, Add Meeting) so the user can interactively test the panel.
Always include `data-testid` on interactive elements as specified in testing_attributes.
